# CANDIDATE: NARROW_ORB_RSI_DIVERGENCE_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to capture edge from bearish reversals triggered by narrow opening range (ORB) combined with bearish RSI divergence. A narrow ORB indicates low initial volatility and indecision, while bearish RSI divergence (price making higher highs while RSI makes lower highs) suggests weakening momentum and potential downside reversal. This setup aligns with the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON playbook context but adds a quantitative trigger for earlier entry.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At the open of the 5-minute bar following a confirmed bearish RSI divergence signal within the first 15 minutes of trading (9:30-9:45 ET), provided the opening range (first 5-minute bar: 9:30-9:35 ET) has a high-low range ≤ 0.2% of the session open price.  
**Bearish RSI divergence:** Defined as the price making a higher high between two consecutive 5-minute bars while the 14-period RSI makes a lower high over the same period (e.g., bar 1 high < bar 2 high AND RSI(bar 1) > RSI(bar 2)).  
**Exit:** Standard BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON rules:  
- Primary stop: 3-minute candle closes above the rejected level (ORB high) + $0.50 buffer  
- Chandelier profit-lock: arms at +5% favor, trails 15% off high-water mark  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET  
- TP1: +50% premium at 2/3 quantity (sell 2 of 3)  
- Runner: remaining 1/3 rides to exit signals (3-min candle closes back into EMA ribbon, rejection signature, or premium ≥ 3× entry)
